sloka: रथानां तु सहस्राणि नागानामयुतानि च ।दशायुतानि चाश्वानामेकैकस्य धनं ददौ ।। ७.१०७.१९ ॥
transliteration: rathānāṁ tu sahasrāṇi nāgānāmayutāni ca ।daśāyutāni cāśvānāmekaikasya dhanaṁ dadau ।। 7.107.19 ॥

translations.english: He gave to each of his sons thousands of chariots, ten thousands of elephants, and one hundred thousand horses as wealth.
